rawContent: Farm workers have a lot to teach Hollywood (and all of us) about #MeToo and how to address sexual harassment at work. Great @slate piece by @bmyeung. Want more? Stay tuned for a new @BetterLifeLab report & toolkit on sexual harassment at work next week! https://t.co/jRh48LTag7

Stay tuned for a new research report and a toolkit out next week from me and my @BetterLifeLab colleagues tackling sexual harassment in the workplace. It's everywhere, but it doesn't have to be. #metoo #sexualharassment

New report from @betterlifelab on the factors enabling #sexualharassment: from isolation, & lack of women at the top, even in "pink collar" fields, to destructive myths about men, women & work, sexual harassment is so often about imbalances of power https://t.co/E7K3KIutg4 #metoo

One major factor contributing to #sexualharassment? Sex segregation in the workforce - both in what sectors people work in & “vertical sex segregation” within sectors, where men hold the high $, high status jobs, even in pink collar fields https://t.co/E7K3KIutg4 #MeToo #NowWhat https://t.co/DeMFiZ9pr0

For more about how to tackle #sexualharassment #metoo read my colleague @elizabethw723 piece out in @qz today on behavioral science approaches for reducing sexual harassment at work. https://t.co/X4HKjfBLC0

Think you'd automatically have legal recourse if you're sexually harassed at work? Turns out, not so much. @aliezadurana details the gaps in the law in @TheAtlantic https://t.co/OxyAiDdl1A #MeToo #sexualharassment #NowWhat
